quiz.question_id: Untuk file kecil yang ingin dibaca seluruhnya sekaligus, API mana yang direkomendasikan lesson?
quiz.question_en: For a small file you want to read entirely at once, which API does the lesson recommend?
options_id: `os.ReadFile`
`bufio.NewScanner`
`os.ReadDir`
`fmt.Fscan`
options_en: `os.ReadFile`
`bufio.NewScanner`
`os.ReadDir`
`fmt.Fscan`

quiz.question_id: Mengapa lesson menyarankan `bufio.Scanner` untuk file besar?
quiz.question_en: Why does the lesson suggest `bufio.Scanner` for large files?
options_id: Karena scanner membaca baris demi baris sehingga lebih efisien daripada memuat seluruh file
Karena scanner otomatis mengedit file saat dibaca
Karena scanner selalu lebih cepat dari semua pendekatan I/O lain
Karena `os.ReadFile` tidak bisa membaca file teks
options_en: Because a scanner reads line by line and is more efficient than loading the whole file
Because a scanner automatically edits the file while reading
Because a scanner is always faster than every other I/O approach
Because `os.ReadFile` cannot read text files

quiz.question_id: Apa yang paling penting dari `defer file.Close()` setelah `os.Open` atau `os.Create` berhasil?
quiz.question_en: What is most important about `defer file.Close()` after `os.Open` or `os.Create` succeeds?
options_id: Menutup file segera sebelum dibaca
Memastikan file ditutup saat fungsi selesai bahkan jika ada return lebih awal
Mengubah file menjadi read-only
Menyinkronkan semua buffer secara otomatis
options_en: It closes the file immediately before reading
It ensures the file is closed when the function ends even if there is an early return
It turns the file into read-only mode
It automatically syncs every buffer

quiz.question_en: Why is `w.Flush()` required after writing with `bufio.Writer`?
options_id: Agar file tertutup otomatis
Agar data buffered benar-benar didorong ke file
Agar permission file berubah menjadi 0644
Agar scanner bisa membaca file yang sama
options_en: So the file closes automatically
So buffered data is actually pushed to the file
So the file permissions change to 0644
So a scanner can read the same file

quiz.question_id: Pada contoh scanner, mengapa perlu memeriksa `scanner.Err()` setelah loop?
quiz.question_en: In the scanner example, why do you need to check `scanner.Err()` after the loop?
options_id: Untuk mengetahui apakah scanning berhenti karena error I/O, bukan hanya karena EOF
Karena `Scan()` tidak pernah mengembalikan false saat EOF
Untuk menutup file secara manual
Untuk menghitung jumlah byte yang dibaca
options_en: To know whether scanning stopped because of an I/O error instead of just EOF
Because `Scan()` never returns false at EOF
To close the file manually
To count the number of bytes read

quiz.question_id: Jika sebuah program menulis banyak baris berturut-turut ke file, pilihan mana yang paling sejalan dengan lesson?
quiz.question_en: If a program writes many lines in succession to a file, which choice best matches the lesson?
options_id: Pakai `bufio.Writer` agar penulisan berulang lebih efisien
Pakai `os.ReadFile` lebih dulu
Pakai `os.Environ` untuk menyimpan baris
Pakai `time.Sleep` di antara setiap `Write`
options_en: Use `bufio.Writer` so repeated writes are more efficient
Use `os.ReadFile` first
Use `os.Environ` to store the lines
Use `time.Sleep` between each `Write`

quiz.question_en: What does the `0644` permission mean in the lesson?
options_id: Owner read+write, group read, others read
Owner read-only, group write, others execute
Semua orang read+write+execute
Hanya owner yang bisa membaca file
options_en: Owner read+write, group read, others read
Owner read-only, group write, others execute
Everyone gets read+write+execute
Only the owner can read the file

quiz.question_id: Tradeoff mana yang paling tepat antara `os.ReadFile` dan scanner berdasarkan lesson?
quiz.question_en: Which tradeoff best captures `os.ReadFile` versus a scanner based on the lesson?
options_id: `os.ReadFile` cocok untuk file kecil, scanner lebih cocok untuk membaca bertahap file besar
Scanner selalu menggantikan `os.ReadFile` di semua kasus
`os.ReadFile` hanya boleh dipakai untuk file biner
Scanner menulis file lebih cepat daripada `bufio.Writer`
options_en: `os.ReadFile` suits small files, while a scanner is better for incremental reading of large files
A scanner always replaces `os.ReadFile` in every case
`os.ReadFile` may only be used for binary files
A scanner writes files faster than `bufio.Writer`

quiz.question_id: Jika `os.Create("output.txt")` berhasil, objek apa yang kemudian dibungkus oleh `bufio.NewWriter` pada contoh?
quiz.question_en: If `os.Create("output.txt")` succeeds, what object is then wrapped by `bufio.NewWriter` in the example?
options_id: Slice byte hasil `ReadFile`
String path `output.txt`
File handle yang dikembalikan `os.Create`
Scanner yang sudah ada
options_en: A byte slice returned by `ReadFile`
The string path `output.txt`
The file handle returned by `os.Create`
An existing scanner

quiz.question_id: Manakah urutan penanganan error yang paling sesuai dengan gaya contoh lesson saat membaca file?
quiz.question_en: Which error-handling order best matches the style shown in the lesson when reading a file?
options_id: Baca file, abaikan error, cetak isi
Baca atau buka file, cek `err`, lalu lanjut memproses jika tidak ada error
Cetak isi dulu lalu cek `err`
Panggil `Close` sebelum cek `err` hasil `Open`
options_en: Read the file, ignore the error, then print the contents
Read or open the file, check `err`, then continue processing only if there is no error
Print the contents first and then check `err`
Call `Close` before checking the `err` from `Open`
